shortDescription.default: Meetings, tensions and outcomes in SharePoint and Microsoft Teams

longDescription.default: Run meetings from shared templates, record tensions or agenda items and agree on outcomes. Everything is stored in your organization's SharePoint site, and the app has no server of its own. Data leaves your tenant only if a site owner switches on the optional AI or roleALPHA connection. The package contains two SharePoint web parts (roleALPHA Sessions for the workspace, roleALPHA Session for a single meeting on a page) and a Microsoft Teams app (personal app, channel and group chat tab, meeting tab). Calendar links and transcripts need administrator consent for Microsoft Graph. Optional AI suggests wording for proposals; people make every decision. It uses Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude in Microsoft Foundry or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, which your organization provides. Governance questions are answered by rALPH, roleALPHA's assistant, in roleALPHA; they and drafts need a roleALPHA account.
